title: How I made a story heavy roguelike solo with AI art, and the part that still needed 30 real people
author: Annual-Kiwi4096
selftext:
Hi, I am the sole developer of **Grim Hand**, a dark fantasy roguelike card game for mobile. It went live this week on Google Play and the App Store.

**Android** : [Link](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.andreyrub.grim_hand&referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Daigamedev)

**iPhone** : [Link](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6791943856?pt=129181029&ct=aigamedev)

The game is story heavy. Four acts, more than 60 enemies with wounded and dead versions of each one, around 90 curious events with their own scene, a cinematic for every boss. In the end it is around 1000 images and around 250 narrated lines. I have no art skills and no budget for an artist, so it was AI art or no game.

Code is written with Claude Code, with manual and automatic QA. I play on the phone for an hour, write down everything that bothered me in one message, and it opens an issue per item and fixes them one by one, with a screenshot of each fix. 

I don't like the agents workflow or one shot attempts. What worked for me is short loops where I am in the middle, one thing at a time, and I see the result before the next one starts. It is slower and it is the only way my vision came to life.

The game design and the writing are mine. All the story, the dialogues, the balance and the rules are mine. I focused on what I am good at.

I hired more than 30 playtesters on Upwork, one at a time, each one recording himself playing the first hour and talking. Watching them was the most usefull thing in the whole project. The tutorial was rewritten ten times because of it and the first fights are changed completely. The decision what to change was always from watching a real person get stuck.

The game is no ads, no pay to win, a free demo and a single unlock. If you liked Dawncaster you will probably feel at home here, it is the same kind of premium mobile roguelike, just darker and with a story that goes somewhere.

Questions and feedback are welcome

Site : [https://grimhand.com](https://grimhand.com)
